scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.emulators: node scripts/preflight-ports.mjs auth firestore hub logging && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore
scripts.emulators:all: node scripts/preflight-ports.mjs auth firestore functions ui hub logging && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,ui
scripts.emulators:autoclean: node scripts/preflight-ports.mjs --auto-clean auth firestore hub logging && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore
scripts.emulators:all:autoclean: node scripts/preflight-ports.mjs --auto-clean auth firestore functions ui hub logging && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,ui
scripts.kill-emulators: pkill -f 'cloud-firestore-emulator' && pkill -f 'firebase emulators:start' && sleep 2 && echo 'Emulator processes killed'
